features: Solar-powered bi-spectrum thermal camera kit with 80 W photovoltaic panel and 36 Ah (360 Wh) lithium battery bank
thermal module: 256x192 VOx uncooled, 12 um pitch, 8-14 um, NETD <= 40 mK, thermal FOV 23.7 x 17.8, digital zoom x2/x4

bi-spectrum image fusion (optical detail overlaid on thermal), target coloration (white/black hot)

release_notes: The Hikvision DS-2TXS2628-8P is a solar-powered, 4G-connected bi-spectrum thermal camera kit with an enlarged 36 Ah battery bank for off-grid fire prevention and perimeter monitoring. Its 256x192 thermal module (8 mm lens) measures temperature (-20 to 150 C) and triggers audible and strobe alarms on VCA or temperature events.

home_assistant.notes: Hikvision-platform ONVIF (default port 80, Profile S/G). Thermal + optical exposed as separate channels.
